response.sql: WITH profile_stats AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), profile_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS mean_avg_bandusagepct FROM profile_stats) SELECT p.weathprofile, p.avg_bandusagepct, p.telescope_count, p.avg_bandusagepct - m.mean_avg_bandusagepct AS difference_from_mean FROM profile_stats AS p CROSS JOIN profile_mean AS m WHERE m.mean_avg_bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
